reviews.text: We have been using this clinic since November of last year. My beloved Cavalier King Charles Spaniel has many chronic illnesses, including cystitis, enteritis, and dermatitis, but I feel at ease because they provide thorough examinations and consultations, and explain the condition and treatment methods in an easy-to-understand way. The doctor and nursing staff are all very kind, and my dog ​​has become very attached to them. The clinic has a spacious waiting area and is bright and clean. In addition to examinations, they also provide total care, including teeth cleaning and grooming.
Thank you for your feedback. We will continue to strive to provide even better animal medical care.
Thank you very much for using our services. We will continue to strive to provide careful treatment and easy-to-understand explanations so that you can visit us with peace of mind in the future.

Today I visited this hospital for my daughter's cat's checkup. This is my second visit, as the veterinarian who previously treated our cat has moved here.

Unusually for Osaka, despite being nestled between buildings, it has two parking spaces. If you're lucky, you can use them, and the road in front of the hospital is relatively wide, making it easy to park for short periods. However, parking is at your own risk.

The hospital is new and very clean. The staff were all kind and helpful, making for a pleasant experience. I would recommend this animal hospital; you can feel confident bringing your pet here.
I had my dog ​​neutered. All the staff were cheerful, and they were very polite and explained everything thoroughly, so I felt at ease before and after the procedure.

I always bring my dog ​​here for checkups.

Everyone is so kind and treats him so well!

My regular vet was closed, and my cat was vomiting repeatedly, so I went to this clinic without an appointment. Luckily, they saw the cat right away. The fact that they were open all day was a huge help. The doctor was very kind and reassuring. I look forward to continuing to use their services.
Thank you very much for your high rating. All of our staff will continue to work hard to meet your expectations. We appreciate your continued support.

This was my first time getting a dog, and I was full of anxiety and worries, but they examined every little thing with compassion! 
They carefully examined things that I wouldn't have noticed, and were kind to the dog, so he seemed at ease during his examination ^^ I'm really glad there's a veterinary hospital like this. I look forward to continuing to support you m(__)m

Our doctors and nurses always provide care with a smile, based on their solid knowledge and medical skills.
Since the stitches were removed, your cat's stomach and intestines have been doing great, and she's acting even more adorable as a princess. Thank you so much for all your help.
We hope to continue to serve you as a reliable family hospital for your cat.

I was worried about my dog's sudden diarrhea, so I went to see him. I'm an extremely anxious person, but he explained everything to me clearly and I felt at ease. The nurses and doctors are very kind! The clinic is also clean, and I attended the tour before it opened, where they showed me around the entire clinic! There are both male and female doctors, so I feel at ease. 😊 I'll be back!

My cat stayed at a pet hotel during a trip to Osaka and reported not urinating for a day and a half. I immediately contacted this hospital and took her in.

Despite the short notice, the doctor was able to perform tests and take ample time to explain everything.

The other staff members were also very kind.

Because of the visit, I was able to return home with peace of mind.

Currently, she is behaving normally and without any problems.

If I lived locally, I would definitely bring her here!

Thank you very much for everything.
The wait was very long.

Last night, I had something on my mind, so I made a last-minute appointment and visited the clinic for the first time.

The hospital has an open feel, with the examination rooms visible from the outside. The doctor and nurses were all very kind and polite, and I felt completely at ease.

Thank you very much!

The doctors and staff are kind and polite, so I feel at ease when I come here for treatment. 
The clinic is clean and they provide excellent care, so I want to keep coming back!
The teachers and staff were very kind!

I learned that a new animal hospital had opened near my home, and because I suspected my dog ​​had choked on food, I quickly called to ask for advice.

During the phone call, they listened carefully to my dog's symptoms and even consulted with a veterinarian. They then told me, "From what you've told me, it's not an emergency right now, but please come in immediately if it gets worse," which I really appreciated. Since there didn't seem to be any problems afterward, I didn't need to visit the hospital, but I will definitely bring my dog ​​here for checkups and preventative medications in the future. Thank you so much!
Thank you for your kind feedback. We will continue to strive to provide even more attentive service to ensure your satisfaction. Please let us know if you have any comments or suggestions.

She always checks on my beloved cat.
She's currently checking on vaccinations, cat fungus, and whether she accidentally ingested cat litter when hungry.
She's very friendly and takes my cat's illness seriously. 🐱
She also loves him so much, which makes me very happy as a pet owner. 🥰
I look forward to continuing to work with her. 🙏💖

My beloved dog is a patient here. The doctor and staff always treat her with such kindness, and now she gets so excited just passing by. The examinations are thorough and the staff are so kind; it's a clinic I definitely want to continue bringing my dog ​​to. ✨

I moved here due to a job transfer, and since this clinic opened around that time, I decided to make it my regular vet.

I've already taken my older child here for teeth cleaning and vaccinations, and I always feel at ease because they thoroughly check the whole body.

The facilities are new and very clean.

I look forward to continuing to use your services.
This is the hospital we've been going to since we brought our dog home. The doctors and staff are all very kind and always greet us with smiles, and our dog loves this hospital too!

Last year, I moved to Osaka with my dog ​​and had a bad experience at another hospital, so I was wondering what to do this year, when Bonaire Hospital came up in my search results. I went there and found it to be a really great hospital! The interior, service, examinations, facilities, doctors, and assistants were all perfect! I was even given a cute walking bag, which will make my walks even more enjoyable. If anything happens again, I will definitely rely on Bonaire Hospital★

We received excellent care for our dog's oral health and grooming needs.

At the vet, it was difficult to discuss anything beyond the immediate concerns, or we were unaware of other issues ourselves. However, the examination here was incredibly thorough; they checked not only our dog's mouth but its entire body, and we were able to discuss many things, which put our minds at ease.

The doctor and staff were very kind and listened attentively. This is a trustworthy vet.

For grooming, they suggested a cut tailored to our dog, and our matted dog became incredibly cute – a complete transformation! I was very impressed with the high level of skill at this salon.

We would definitely like to visit again for both the vet and grooming!

While walking my dog, it was bitten by another dog, and we went straight to the clinic for an examination.

They carefully examined not only the wound but also whether there were any other abnormalities, and during disinfection, they treated the dog gently, talking to it while keeping an eye on it.

Even though we rushed to the clinic, they explained the condition of the wound in detail, and we were greatly relieved to know that it wasn't serious.

Thank you very much.

The clinic was bright and clean, and there were various payment options available.

If we ever need to go to the hospital again, we would like to use their services.
